title: Trackit
description: A low-overhead Linux system monitor written in C++17. It reads kernel telemetry directly from the /proc filesystem (/proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, and /proc/[pid]/stat) at 500ms intervals, avoiding subprocess spawning overhead. Displays real-time scrolling CPU load, memory utilization, and process status using Dear ImGui and OpenGL 3.3 with a 1.3% CPU footprint.

title: Panopteez
description: An end-to-end distributed observability pipeline. C++ daemon agents gather host system metrics and stream authenticated HTTP payloads to a Node/Express ingestion collector, persisting data into PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM. Orchestrated into a multi-agent cluster using Docker Compose.

title: AI Farmers Assistant
description: Agricultural intelligence platform built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2025). Integrates live mandi commodity pricing feeds, soil-climate classification, and bilingual advisory chat. Led a 6-member student engineering team to win the college selection round.
metrics: SIH 2025 College Round 1st Place • Team of 6
